pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.subtitle: Action runs announced by CI, one row per commit: the row speaks with its newest run and opens to show the attempts behind it.
pipelines.counters.supersededHint: a newer run of the same commit re-evaluated these findings
pipelines.empty.title: No Action has reached the platform yet
pipelines.empty.hint: A workflow running the Shauron action announces itself here before it starts scanning. A scan started by hand from the CLI or the console is a scanner run and lives in Orchestration.
pipelines.superseded.hint: a newer run of the same commit re-evaluated these findings — that run owns them now
pipelines.superseded.body: This run reported {n} finding(s). A newer run of the same commit re-evaluated them and owns them now — the live numbers are on that row.
pipelines.verdict.note: The verdict is the gate: HIGH and above block. The CI job can still report success — that reports the process, this reports the findings.
pipelines.findings.reportedHint: reported {n} finding(s) when it finished; a newer run of the same commit now owns them
pipelines.findings.closedNote: {n} finding(s) here are closed (resolved, accepted risk, false positive or suppressed): they are listed, and they do not block the gate.
pipelines.findings.reEvaluatedEmpty: These findings were re-evaluated by a newer run of the same commit; open that row to read them.
pipelines.findings.noneEmpty: This action produced no finding — an empty list is a result, not a gap.
pipelines.drawer.title: Action {action} · {sha}
builder.title: New pipeline
builder.subtitle: A pipeline announces a commit; the platform scans it and the build waits on the verdict.
builder.subtitleFull: Four steps, and the file your repository needs at the end. Its runs land in Pipelines as commit rows with their verdict.
builder.error.clipboard: the clipboard refused the file; select it and copy by hand
builder.empty.noProject.title: No project to attach a pipeline to
builder.empty.noProject.hint: A pipeline belongs to a component of a project, and a component needs a repository. Create the project first.
builder.field.apiUrl: API root the runner calls — written into the file as BARAD_URL
builder.warning.noRepository: This component has no repository bound, and every action here reads a checkout: the repository binding is the authorization a CI run relies on. Attach it in Projects → {project} → components.
builder.note.catalog: The catalog is closed: these are the actions this platform knows how to run, and each names the tasks it must produce. An action that reaches the network is the platform acting alone, so it needs a grant and runs from the console — a pipeline can announce, but it cannot authorize. Every flow fails closed: HIGH and above block the build, and a run that did not deliver all its tasks certifies nothing.
builder.note.repeatedBefore: A task in two actions runs once per flow:
builder.note.networkBefore: A CI runner does not share this console's network:
builder.note.networkAfter: is the runner's own machine. Left empty, the file reads a repository variable instead of carrying an address that only works here.
builder.note.file: This screen creates nothing on the platform: the file is the pipeline. Commit it and the next push announces itself — the run appears under Pipelines as a commit row with its verdict.
builder.file.building.title: Building the file…
builder.file.building.refused: The platform refused the selection; read the banner above.
builder.file.building.hint: The workflow is generated from the three previous steps.
gates.title: Quality gates
gates.column.name: name
gates.field.name: policy name
gates.empty.policies: No gate policies — evaluation uses the default HIGH threshold.
regression.title: Security regression
regression.authNote: Execution requires an active authorization grant for the target (capability active_verification); mutating methods also need intrusive_testing.
regression.field.name: check name
regression.reintroducedMsg: REGRESSION: this check passed before and now fails.
pentest.title: Pentests
pentest.report.title: report
pentest.field.name: engagement name
pentest.lead: The pentests this platform runs are cycles: a window, a frozen scope and a ledger of claims that only become findings once a person confirms them.
pentest.campaigns.title: Pentest campaigns (CTEM cycles)
pentest.campaigns.empty: No pentest cycle yet. A pentest is created as a CTEM cycle of kind pentest_external or pentest_internal — that is what freezes the scope and records who decided what.
regression.lead: A regression check re-runs the proof a finding was closed with. If it fails again, the weakness came back — that is the only thing this screen measures.
regression.verdict: Passing: {passing} · failing: {failing} · weakness came back: {back} · never run: {never}
